title: Bacterial and fungal diversity of ancient Rotunda of Sts. Felix and Adauctus of Wawel Royal Castle in Krakow, Poland
description: The aim of the study was to investigate microbial diversity of Rotunda of Sts. Felix and Adauctus which is the oldest and most valuable historical buidling of Wawel Royal Castle in Krakow, Poland.
center: Research & Development Life Sciences Limited Company
